sloka: विभीषणस्य चैश्वर्यं भविष्यति हते त्वयि ।न चेत् सत्कृत्य वैदेहीं प्रणिपत्य प्रदास्यसि ।। ६.४१.८० ।।।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇasya caiśvaryaṁ bhaviṣyati hate tvayi ।na cet satkṛtya vaidehīṁ praṇipatya pradāsyasi ।। 6.41.80 ।।।।

translations.english: "You and your son's relatives and followers being killed (by me) the three worlds will be rid of fear of you."
